entries.title: Favouring one side of the family
entries.odia:
ଆପଣା ଭଉଣୀ ନ ପାଏ ଭାତଗୁଣ୍ଡା
ଶଳାଶାଳୀ ପାଇଁ ଥୁଆ କ୍ଷୀରମଣ୍ଡା ।
entries.literal_meaning: One’s own sister gets no mouthful of rice, while milk cakes await the brothers- and sisters-in-law.
entries.explanation: The contrast criticises conspicuous favour for one set of relatives while someone close goes without. It questions unequal care, not the worth of either relationship.
entries.meaning_odia: ଗୋଟିଏ ପକ୍ଷର ଆତ୍ମୀୟଙ୍କୁ ଆଦର କରି ନିଜର ଅନ୍ୟ ଆତ୍ମୀୟଙ୍କ ଆବଶ୍ୟକତା ଅବହେଳା କରିବାକୁ ଏହି କଥା ସମାଲୋଚନା କରେ।
entries.usage_example: A host arranges expensive gifts for guests while ignoring a sibling’s urgent need. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
entries.cultural_context: The food contrast is imagery; no universal household custom is asserted.

entries.title: Coincidence is not cause

entries.usage_example: A machine stops just as someone enters; that timing alone does not show they caused it. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)

entries.cultural_context: Dheṅki is a large husking implement; swallowing it is hyperbole, not an action to imitate.
